source.note: Base and insert numerical checklists transcribed from BaseballCardPedia and cross-checked against the linked TCDB set, insert index, and rookie index. Team blocks follow the TCDB base checklist. No third-party images are copied.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Hobby. The physical product held six cards per pack, 24 packs per box, plus one separate Cel-Cube box topper. VCS uses its four-card digital pack format and keeps 24 packs per box.
decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: One 200-card Base ProductSet, six other explicitly numbered checklists, four complete 50-card Pennant Fever parallels, and the three signed Tony Gwynn variants. Total: 523 collector entries across 11 ProductSets.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: The linked TCDB rookie index identifies only base #24 Magglio Ordonez, #78 Rolando Arrojo, #139 John Halama, and #168 Masato Yoshii as true RC cards. Insert appearances do not inherit RC.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the subject name and verified base RC designation. Serial numbering, autograph status and printed-number collisions are in variant or ProductSet notes.
decisions.oddsPlacement: Known Hobby odds are on ProductSets. Pennant Fever is 1:1, Hardball Cel-Fusions 1:73, and Kings of the Major Leagues 1:361. On Deck's reported 4:37 ratio cannot be represented exactly as integer 1:N, so its odds remain null pending pack-engine support. Platinum Blue, Copper and Tony Gwynn autograph odds are unpublished and remain null.
decisions.boxTopper: Cubes are three-dimensional box toppers, one per Hobby box. They are retained as a collector ProductSet with null pack odds rather than falsely inserted into ordinary packs.
decisions.retailExclusives: Pennant Fever Red (reported 1:4 Retail packs) and Silver (Retail-only, SN250, odds unpublished) retain their full collector checklists. Both have null odds in the canonical Hobby pack; a separate Retail configuration is needed to rip them authentically.
decisions.autographNumbers: TCDB assigns the same printed AU1 number to three unique signed Tony Gwynn parallels. AU1-C, AU1-PB and AU1-S are distinct import keys, and each variant preserves printed AU1 and its underlying parallel.
decisions.promo: Dealer-distributed Tony Gwynn SAMPLE is excluded because it was not a Hobby pack or box outcome.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased pending images, pricing, exact On Deck odds support, box-topper handling, and separate Retail pack configuration.

productSets.name: Pennant Fever
productSets.notes: Complete #1-50 insert checklist; one per physical pack in Hobby and Retail.

productSets.name: Cubes
productSets.notes: 20 numbered three-dimensional Cel-Cubes. One separate box topper per sealed Hobby box; not a card in an ordinary pack.

productSets.name: On Deck Laser Cuts
productSets.notes: 20 cards. Published insertion ratio is 4:37 packs, which cannot be represented exactly by this importer's integer 1:N odds field.

productSets.name: Pennant Fever Red
productSets.notes: Full 50-card Pennant Fever Red parallel. Retail-exclusive 1:4; unavailable in canonical Hobby pack.

productSets.name: Pennant Fever Silver
productSets.notes: Full 50-card Pennant Fever Silver parallel; SN250; Retail-exclusive; insertion odds unpublished.

productSets.name: Pennant Fever Platinum Blue
productSets.notes: Full 50-card Pennant Fever Platinum Blue parallel; SN100; insertion odds unpublished.

productSets.name: Pennant Fever Copper
productSets.notes: Full 50-card Pennant Fever Copper parallel; SN20; insertion odds unpublished.

productSets.name: Pennant Fever Tony Gwynn Autographs
productSets.notes: Three unique one-of-one signed copies of Pennant Fever Copper, Platinum Blue, and Silver. All printed AU1; distinct internal suffixes resolve the card-number collision. Odds unpublished.
